maddeler.e:
نشتبك (form VIII)
# نَشْتَبِكُ (naštabiku) /naʃ.ta.bi.ku/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَبَكَ (ištabaka)
# نَشْتَبِكَ (naštabika) /naʃ.ta.bi.ka/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِشْتَبَكَ (ištabaka)
# نَشْتَبِكْ (naštabik) /naʃ.ta.bik/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِشْتَبَكَ (ištabaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
